                                       Resolution 2026-06
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

                 RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
   FOR THE ANNUAL REPLACEMENT OF FIRE DEPARTMENT HOSE,
                 TOOLS, TURNOUTS AND BEDS

   WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue annually tests fire hose and equipment and anticipates replacing
    approximately $10,000 of fire hose and equipment in 2026; and

   WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue needs to replace 6 mattresses using Municipal supply contract at an
    anticipated cost of $4,800 total; and

   WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue annually replaces 3-4 sets of turnouts and personal protective firefighting
    equipment at an anticipated cost of $5,200 total; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Fire and Rescue Board on April 28, 2026 approved by resolution support of these
    purchases from the Girdwood Fire Department 406 capital account.

   THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the purchase of hose, firefighting tools, turnouts and
    mattresses at a combined cost not to exceed $20,000 (TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLARS).

    Passed by a vote of 5 in favor 0 opposed this 15th day of June, 2026.



   Nick Crews                                    Margaret Tyler
  GBOS Fire Liaison                                 Attest
